item.title: Has W Social switched to closed source?
item.description:
📝 So here we go, with another article about W Social on their big week, as they are set to open their public beta to their waiting list later today. Someone wrote to me:W Social have taken down the public repo of their app: https://github. That means that the European Commission has factually migrated their data from an open source platform (Bluesky) into a closed source platform (W Social).
🔗 Read more: https://blog.elenarossini.com/w-social-public-institutions-and-the-theater-of-european-digital-sovereignty/
